annotations.title: Place several orders at once (spends balance)

description: Place up to 25 orders in one go — several services, one link or several — paid together from the balance. THIS SPENDS THE USER'S REAL BALANCE (USD) and starts delivery. Use it when the user wants several things at once (e.g. followers + likes + views for one account); for one order use place_order. Every order is checked first at today's price: if any one cannot go (link does not fit, quantity out of range, too many running on one link, balance short…) NONE is placed and each item says why. Then they are placed one by one; should one fail at that very moment, the others stay placed and that one says why (nothing charged for it). Without `confirm: true` nothing is charged: you get each price and the total so you can ask the user. With `confirm: true` also pass `max_total` = the total the user agreed to; if prices moved above it nothing is placed (price_changed). Pass a fresh `idempotency_key` per intended batch: a retry with the same key never places an order twice. Each item takes what place_order takes: `service`, `link`, `quantity`, or `inputs` for services with an `input`. Errors: batch_invalid (details.items says which and why), insufficient_balance (details.shortfall = USD to top up — call get_top_up_info), order_rate_limited, over_daily_cap, price_changed, idempotency_conflict.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually place and charge. Only after the user agreed to the total.

dry_run.description: true = check and price only, never charge.

idempotency_key.description: Unique string per intended batch; a retry with the same key returns the first orders.

inputs.description: Order fields, for services with an `input` (see find_services).

answer_number.description: Poll votes: the option to vote for, 1 = the first.

comments.description: Custom comments: one per line, or a list. Their number is the quantity.

delay.description: Subscriptions: minutes after a post goes up before it starts (0, 5, 10 … 600).

hashtag.description: Mentions by hashtag: one hashtag, e.g. "#yourbrand".

max.description: Subscriptions: the most each new post gets.

min.description: Subscriptions: the least each new post gets.

old_posts.description: Subscriptions: also this many of the latest posts (0–50).

posts.description: Subscriptions: how many future posts it covers (1–500).

runs.description: Spread the order over this many runs (2–100); `quantity` is then per run.

username.description: An account: whose followers get mentioned, whose comment gets the likes, or a subscription’s account.

usernames.description: Mentions: the accounts to mention, one per line, or a list. Their number is the quantity.

link.description: The URL to deliver to. Must fit the service.

quantity.description: How many units. Leave out where the inputs count it or it is fixed.

max_total.description: The total in USD the user agreed to, e.g. "12.34": nothing is placed if today's prices come to more.

name: place_orders
title: Place several orders at once (spends balance)
